title: Arrest
question: What does Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 section 228 say about arrest?
shortAnswer: Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 s.228 — Customs officer may arrest without warrant on reasonable suspicion of customs offence.
legalExplanation:
**Section 228 of the Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023** provides:

Customs officer may arrest without warrant on reasonable suspicion of customs offence

This provision empowers Nigeria Customs Service Act 2023 officers with specific powers and duties.
practicalOptions: Stay calm. Know your rights. Ask for identification. Do not resist. Ask for lawyer. Document everything.
whatToAvoid: Do not run, bribe, resist, destroy evidence, or sign without lawyer.
whatToDocument: Officer name, agency, badge, vehicle, time, location, witnesses, injuries, photos/video.
whatToDoAfter: Get lawyer. File complaint with agency complaints unit or ICPC/PCR. Demand court within 24h. Document injuries.
